summary.text: Soul Explosion is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move under Emperor Yama, a named aspect that spends one yama child for a peak rank seven blast of dark waves.

claims.text: Against Meng Tu, Fang Yuan in Emperor Yama form inwardly calls the killer move Soul explosion. The emperor yama spreads its arms and vast waves of darkness erupt from it; the yama children stay safe in the dark waves while the blade path phantoms are instantly extinguished and the battlefield clears. Meng Tu is sent back hundreds of steps and half-kneels on the ground as he pushes his defensive killer moves to their limits. One yama child is completely used, producing peak rank seven power that still does not reach rank eight, and Fang Yuan lists soul explosion with defense, yama child, and recovery as emperor yama aspects at the peak of rank seven.
Fang Yuan activates immortal killer move soul explosion and a vast wave of darkness surges toward Meng Tu. Meng Tu is submerged by the dark waves, then self-detonates in bright blade lights.

On empty ground a thousand li from Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan activates Emperor Yama and then Soul Explosion, moving a finger as black smoke shoots out and destroys everything in its path. Cloud Cover Continent’s immortal formation shines in silver light and blunts much of the force, yet a killer move at the peak of rank seven still cannot be fully stopped, and after a chain of explosions the area of several li is decimated. When the smoke ends, one yama child on the imperial robe vanishes after a few breaths, which is the price of the move.
Inside yama battlefield, Fang Yuan attacks in emperor yama form with a yama child army and mixes soul explosions among them, causing great damage to Feng Jiu Ge until blood flows from his mouth.

Pressed for time as yama battlefield starts to shake, Fang Yuan uses Soul Explosion again, this time detonating an immemorial yama child rather than an ordinary one. He had turned two immemorial soul beasts into yama children; ancient yama child soul explosion is a peak rank seven killer move, while immemorial yama child soul explosion is rank eight, and that blast hits Feng Jiu Ge directly.

Feng Jiu Ge survives the immemorial yama soul explosion: his seven orifices bleed, but a thin light armor around his body saves his life, and he names rank eight Immortal Gu Fate Armor. Fang Yuan still has another immemorial yama child.

Fang Yuan shouts that he will kill Lang Ya land spirit and uses immemorial yama child Soul Explosion; pitch black smoke spreads and engulfs the land spirit. Fang Yuan stands at the centre like the eye of a tornado and is unharmed, while anyone approaching must resist the blast and its dense soul path dao marks, which restrict their immortal killer moves. The land spirit teleports away before the move takes his life.

After yama children close on Bing Zhuo, Fang Yuan makes one self-detonate as immortal killer move Soul Explosion; Bing Zhuo cannot dodge at that range, and the explosion destroys his corpse entirely. Appearing in Southern Border, Fang Yuan then fires five to six soul explosions in a row, each at rank seven peak power, until two Gu Immortals flee in fear.

Fang Yuan judges that his strongest method is now an immemorial yama child’s soul explosion, but he has no immemorial soul beasts left to modify, having already used both immemorial yama children, one aimed at Feng Jiu Ge and the other at Lang Ya land spirit, with neither kill succeeding. An ancient yama child’s soul explosion is similar in power to myriad dragon, and yama battlefield amplifies it so it is slightly stronger.

Against cloud bamboo mountain range’s immortal formation, Fang Yuan finds soul explosion more suited to destroying the formation than his prior barrage and uses yama child soul explosion without hesitation.

Fang Yuan waves his sleeves and black smoke spreads as soul explosion, a rank seven peak method that destroys the core of cloud bamboo mountain range’s immortal formation with ease, after which the rest of the formation collapses.
